verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway and router. An AI platform of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence covers per-request features only (routing, fallbacks, load balancing, caching, the prompt library and the MCP gateway) and never mentions scheduling, cron, or recurring job execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
